visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Answer Queries from Prefix Sums
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each query adds up its range with a fresh loop. Build the prefix array once and answer every query with one subtraction. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Looping per query costs the range length every time. With the prefix array built once, each query takes constant time, which matters when there are many queries on a long array.
